items.title: Here/there/where
items.pattern: ここ・そこ・あそこ・どこ
items.explanation: Place words: near speaker, near listener, away from both and where. 駅はどこですか asks the station's location.

items.title: Positions relative to an object
items.pattern: N の 上/下/中/外/左/右 に
items.explanation: The reference object's の connects to the position. 駅の左に寺があります places the temple left of the station, not the reverse.

items.title: No thing/person present
items.pattern: ありません / いません
items.explanation: Nonliving things use ありません; people/animals use いません. あそこに店はありません denies a shop's presence there, not the identity of that place.

items.title: Negative noun/な-description
items.pattern: N / な-stem ではありません
items.explanation: Quiet is 静か; its polite negative is 静かではありません, not 静かくない. あそこは店ではありません denies that place is a shop; compare existential ありません.

items.title: そして and でも
items.explanation: そして continues a sequence or adds a sentence; でも introduces contrast. Neither requires a new verb conjugation.

items.title: と for a companion
items.pattern: person と destination に 行きます
items.explanation: Names the travel companion, as 友だちと花巻に行きます; distinguish noun-listing と and the meeting partner に with 会う.

items.title: に for the person met
items.explanation: The taught 会う pattern uses に for the person met. A time に and an action-location で can occur in the same sentence.
